module: Auxiliary drive modes controller (Eco, Sport, Snow, etc., or differential/range modes for a 4x4). Each mode is a set of typed settings applied all at once when the mode changes: exhaust, turbo, supercharger, automatic gearbox, parameters of another controller (`setParameters`), mode of a powertrain device, electrics value, radial menu entry and simplified control panel button. Several can be instantiated (one per function: driving, differential, range...). The default mode is applied in initLastStage.
usage:
local dm = controller.getControllerSafe("driveModes")
dm.nextDriveMode()
print(dm.getCurrentDriveModeKey())
dm.setDriveMode("sport", true)
notes: Instance jbeam keys: `uiName`, `quickAccessTitle` ("ui.radialmenu2.ESC"), `quickAccessIcon`, `quickAccessLevel` ("/vehicleFeatures/"), `radialIcon`, `defaultMode` (key of the initial mode), `defaultSettings` (header table of settings applied to all modes). All keys starting with `modes` (e.g. modes, modes_sport) are merged into a single table of modes; all those starting with `enabledModes` list the keys of the modes actually usable.

A mode: `{name, order, settings}` where settings is a header table of settings. Setting types recognized by applyDriveMode: "exhaust" (name, mufflingOffset, gainOffset), "turbocharger" (name, wastegateOffset), "supercharger" (name, bypassPressure), "transmission" (defaultForwardMode, calls `controller.mainController.setDefaultForwardMode`), "quickAccess" (icon, title), "simpleControlButton" (buttonId, uiName, icon, color, offColor, offColorElectric, onClick, remove), "controller" (controllerName + other fields passed to the target controller's `setParameters`), "powertrainDeviceMode" (deviceName, mode), "electricsValue" (electricsName, value).

A setting's key = `key`, otherwise deviceName, electricsName, controllerName or type. A mode's setting replaces the one from `defaultSettings` with the same key. Application order: the settings with key `yawControl` and `tractionControl` are sorted first (rank 0), all others have rank 1 (relative order among them not guaranteed).
Anomaly: the duplicate order test in init looks at `driveModes[mode.order]` whereas the table is keyed by mode key, so it normally detects nothing.
The `driveModes` and `enabledDriveModes` tables are module-level and are not emptied in init.
`reset` only resets the radial menu title and icon; the active mode is reapplied by resetLastStage.
Saved state: `getState` returns the key under `<name>ActiveMode`; `serialize` returns {activeDriveModeKey, activeDriveModeIndex}.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: updates the color (active or off) of the simplified control buttons according to their `offColorElectric` electrics.

setSimpleControlButton.desc: Creates, updates or removes a button of the simplified control panel (`ui_simplePowertrainControl`). The default click calls this controller's `nextDriveMode()`.

offColorElectric.desc: Electrics name: at 1 or more, the button takes `offColor`.

updateSimpleControlButtons.desc: Sends the state of all buttons back to the simplified control panel (called by controller.updateSimpleControlButtons).

setDriveMode.desc: Activates the mode with the given key: finds its index among the enabled modes, applies all its settings and displays a UI message unless silent. Unknown or nil key: does nothing.

silent.desc: true to not display a message.

nextDriveMode.desc: Switches to the next enabled mode, wrapping back to the first at the end.

previousDriveMode.desc: Switches to the previous enabled mode, wrapping back to the last at the start.

getCurrentDriveModeKey.desc: Returns the key of the active mode.

returns.desc: Key of the active mode, nil if none.

getDriveModeData.desc: Returns a mode's data (key, name, order, settings, settingsOrder).

reset.desc: Restores the radial menu title and icon read from the jbeam.

resetLastStage.desc: Reapplies the active mode after the reset.

serialize.desc: Returns the active mode for the save.

deserialize.desc: Restores the active mode from serialize.

getState.desc: Returns the key of the active mode under `<name>ActiveMode`.

setState.desc: Silently activates the given mode if it exists and differs from the active mode.

init.desc: Reads the modes (`modes*` keys), the enabled modes (`enabledModes*`) and the default settings from the jbeam, sorts the modes and registers the radial menu entry.

initLastStage.desc: Chooses the default mode (`defaultMode` if enabled, otherwise the first) and applies it.
